# v0.1.2-alpha

## Install (recommended — fully on your phone)
1. Download **btcg-<tag>-full.zip** below (about 1.1 GB — Wi-Fi recommended).
2. Install the APK inside (allow "install from this source" if asked — normal
   for apps outside a store).
3. Open the app, tap **Select the model file**, and pick the zip (or the
   extracted .gguf). The app verifies it automatically — no unzipping needed
   if you pick the zip directly.

## Downloads
- `btcg-<tag>-full.zip` — APK + model + checksums + install guide (recommended)
- `btcg-<tag>.apk` — app only (if you already have the model file)

## Verify (optional — the app also checks by itself)
SHA-256 (see `btcg-<tag>-SHA256SUMS.txt`):
```
<zip hash>  btcg-<tag>-full.zip
<apk hash>  btcg-<tag>.apk
```

## Notes
- The app holds **no INTERNET permission**: it cannot go online even by
  accident. The model file must be provided once, locally.
- Importing needs about 1.1 GB free storage during setup (the app can delete
  the original file afterwards).
- Uninstalling the app deletes the imported model — keep the zip until you're
  settled, or re-download.
- Alpha software: answers are grounded in a curated corpus and can still be
  wrong — verify anything important.
